# Taskboard CLI

A dependency-free TypeScript task manager for [Bun](https://bun.sh/). Tasks are stored in `.taskboard.json` in the current directory, or at the path supplied through `TASKBOARD_FILE`. Each invocation writes exactly one JSON value to stdout.

## Usage

```sh
bun run src/cli.ts add --title "Ship release" --tags work,urgent --due 2026-09-10
bun run src/cli.ts list --status open --tag work
bun run src/cli.ts list --overdue 2026-09-11
bun run src/cli.ts done 1
bun run src/cli.ts delete 1
bun run src/cli.ts stats
```

Use another database file like this:

```sh
TASKBOARD_FILE=/path/to/tasks.json bun run src/cli.ts list
```

Tags are trimmed, lowercased, and deduplicated. Dates must be real calendar dates in `YYYY-MM-DD` form. Failed commands return a non-zero exit status, print a JSON error value to stdout, and send the diagnostic text to stderr. Database updates use a sibling temporary file followed by an atomic rename.

/bin/zsh -lc 'set -eu
repo="$PWD"
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
db="$tmpdir/tasks.json"
run() { TASKBOARD_FILE="$db" bun run "$repo/src/cli.ts" "$@"; }

out=$(run list)
test "$out" = '"'[]'

one="'$(run add --title '"'  First task  ' --tags ' Work,urgent,work ' --due 2026-09-03)
two="'$(run add --title '"'Second task' --tags 'home' --due 2026-09-05)
ONE=\""'$one" TWO="$two" bun -e '"'const a=JSON.parse(process.env.ONE); const b=JSON.parse(process.env.TWO); if(a.id"'!==1||a.title!=="First task"||a.status!=="open"||JSON.stringify(a.tags)!==JSON.stringify(["work","urgent"])||a.due!=="2026-09-03"||!a.createdAt) throw Error("bad first add"); if(b.id!==2) throw Error("bad second id")'"'

listed="'$(run list --status open --tag WORK --overdue 2026-09-04)
LISTED="$listed" bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(process.env.LISTED); if(x.length"'!==1||x[0].id!==1) throw Error("bad filters")'"'

done1="'$(run done 1)
done2=$(run done 1)
DONE1="$done1" DONE2="$done2" bun -e '"'const a=JSON.parse(process.env.DONE1); const b=JSON.parse(process.env.DONE2); if(a.status"'!=="done"||!a.completedAt||a.completedAt!==b.completedAt) throw Error("done not idempotent")'"'

stats="'$(run stats)
STATS="$stats" bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(process.env.STATS); if(x.total"'!==2||x.open!==1||x.done!==1||typeof x.overdue!=="number") throw Error("bad stats")'"'

run delete 1 >/dev/null
three="'$(run add --title Third)
THREE="$three" bun -e '"'if(JSON.parse(process.env.THREE).id"'!==3) throw Error("id reused")'"'

cp \""'$db" "$tmpdir/before.json"
if run add --title '"'' >\""'$tmpdir/error.out" 2>"$tmpdir/error.err"; then exit 20; fi
bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(await Bun.file(process.argv[1]).text()); if(typeof x.error"'!=="string") throw Error("failure stdout not JSON")'"' \""'$tmpdir/error.out"
test -s "$tmpdir/error.err"
cmp "$db" "$tmpdir/before.json"

printf '"'{bad json' > \""'$db"
cp "$db" "$tmpdir/malformed-before.json"
if run list >"$tmpdir/malformed.out" 2>"$tmpdir/malformed.err"; then exit 21; fi
bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(await Bun.file(process.argv[1]).text()); if(typeof x.error"'!=="string") throw Error("malformed stdout not JSON")'"' \""'$tmpdir/malformed.out"
cmp "$db" "$tmpdir/malformed-before.json"

for args in '"'wat' 'list --bogus x' 'done nope' 'delete 999'; do
  if TASKBOARD_FILE=\""'$tmpdir/fresh.json" bun run "$repo/src/cli.ts" $args >"$tmpdir/fail.out" 2>"$tmpdir/fail.err"; then exit 22; fi
  bun -e '"'JSON.parse(await Bun.file(process.argv[1]).text())' \""'$tmpdir/fail.out"
done

bun test

git status --short
printf '"'SELF_TESTS_OK\\n'"
